Gain math: 7 bp inserted; 7 mod 3 = 1 → out-of-frame (net frameshift of +1 nt downstream of the new splice). Exon phase at the new splice: phase 1 (intron splits codon 1|2; previous exon contributes 1 nt to the junction codon). Junction codons read from the spliced mRNA:
  • aa 71: GCT → Ala (A) [1 nt prev exon + 2 nt insert]
  • aa 72: TTT → Phe (F) [3 nt insert]
  • aa 73: AGT → Ser (S) [2 nt insert + 1 nt next exon]
The re-read ORF is expected to encounter a premature termination codon (PTC); see the truncation block below for the predicted stop and NMD call.
Junction insert (intronic cDNA, spliced in): CTTTTAG (7 bp; not a multiple of 3 → out-of-frame gain at the splice). First re-read: GCT (Ala).

Acceptor Gain +7 nt from canonical (SpliceAI gain 1.00). Out-of-frame → PTC at aa 76 (p.Ala71fsTer6) — new stop falls in exon 3 of 11 coding exons. Truncated protein ≈ 75 aa (of 428; 82.5% C-term lost). NMD: predicted (internal exon). PTC location detail: PTC lies in exon 3 (an internal coding exon; last coding exon is exon 11) → predicted to undergo NMD.

• The Variant: DDX39B c.212-8A>G → a structural splice LOF at exon 3 (PTC in exon 2).
  • Truncation & NMD: NMD predicted — stop removes 79.0% of the 428-aa DDX39B protein before decay.
  • Splice products: Product 1 (gain / cryptic junction) — canonical junction acceptor gain:
    SpliceAI signal: canonical junction acceptor gain — DS_AG 1.00 at Δ−1 bp from variant.
    Geometry: cryptic 3′ splice acceptor strengthened vs canonical junction (SpliceAI DS_AG 1.00) → alternative splice geometry; Junction insert: +7 nt; CTTTTAG (7 bp) → out-of-frame frameshift downstream of the new splice site.
    Frame: out-of-frame.
    Premature termination: p.Ala71fsTer6.
    Protein length: truncated ≈ 75/428 aa (82.5% C-terminus lost vs full-length reference).
    NMD: predicted (internal exon PTC).
    Junction codons: 7 bp inserted (out-of-frame, +1 nt frameshift); phase 1; junction codons: aa71 GCT→Ala(A) [1 nt prev exon + 2 nt insert]; aa72 TTT→Phe(F) [3 nt insert]; aa73 AGT→Ser(S) [2 nt insert + 1 nt next exon] → expected PTC in the re-read ORF.
    Computational splice model only — not RNA/minigene evidence.

    Product 2 (loss / exon skip) — canonical acceptor loss → whole-exon skip:
    SpliceAI signal: canonical acceptor loss → whole-exon skip — DS_AL 0.98 at Δ−8 bp from variant.
    Geometry: canonical 3′ splice site abolished; whole-exon-3 skip is the dominant loss product; exon length 128 bp (not a multiple of 3); out-of-frame skip → frameshift downstream of the junction; ~9.8% C-term affected.
    Frame: out-of-frame.
    Premature termination: fsTer21, novel stop in exon 4 (≈aa 91 before termination in the re-read ORF).
    Protein length: truncated ≈ 90/428 aa (79.0% C-terminus lost vs full-length reference).
    NMD: predicted (frameshift → PTC in an internal coding exon).
    Computational splice model only — not RNA/minigene evidence.

    Whole-exon-skip baseline (size + % of protein — used for the <10% / ≥10% PVS1/PM4 SOP decision): Exon 3 length 128 bp: not a multiple of 3 — Out-of-Frame Shift → 42 amino acids lost (9.8% of protein). NMD Phase Shift generates 20 new amino acids before a novel Stop Codon (fsTer21, TGA) which natively maps into Exon 4 of the spliced CDS. Predicted protein: p.Gly71fsTer21. (Exon 1 is 5′-UTR only; mRNA exon numbers still count all exons, including that one.)

    SOP logic: out-of-frame shift (9.8% of protein lost in the spliced product) → PVS1 by default (NMD-predicted unless the variant escapes NMD).
